description: Makes a folder in a mailbox, at the top or under another folder, to file threads in. Every holder of the box sees it, in the webmail and in their mail client. A name holds no "/", "*" nor "%", is unique among its neighbours, and at the top is none of the six every mailbox has.

box.description: The address of the mailbox to look in, for example "simon@sonentreprise.com": call list_sender_addresses to find it. A support queue is not a mailbox and has no folders.

name.description: The name of the folder, 200 characters at most.

parent_id.description: The folder it goes under, by its id from list_folders. Left out, it goes at the top.

name: create_folder
title: Make a folder in a mailbox
